BUILDING CONSTRUCTION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: BUILDING CONSTRUCTION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Building Material Schedules, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Building Material Schedules.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Material Schedules.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Building Material Schedules.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Building Material Schedules.

2. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. International Cricket Team

3. When learning Fixings and Fittings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Fixings and Fittings.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Fixings and Fittings.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fixings and Fittings.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Fixings and Fittings.

4. When learning Waste Water Disposal, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Waste Water Disposal.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Waste Water Disposal.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Waste Water Disposal.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Waste Water Disposal.

5. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

6. When learning Introduction to Building Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Building Drawing.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Building Drawing.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Building Drawing.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Building Drawing.

7. When learning Computer Aided Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Aided Drawing.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Aided Drawing.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Computer Aided Drawing.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Aided Drawing.

8. When learning Building Construction Project Phase 11, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Building Construction Project Phase 11.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Building Construction Project Phase 11.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Construction Project Phase 11.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Building Construction Project Phase 11.

9. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Overload every socket

10. When learning Floor Finishes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Floor Finishes.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Floor Finishes.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Floor Finishes.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Floor Finishes.

11. When learning Pre-cast Concrete Products, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Pre-cast Concrete Products.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pre-cast Concrete Products.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pre-cast Concrete Products.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pre-cast Concrete Products.

12. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Monitor
   B. Keyboard
   C. Speaker
   D. CPU

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Waste Water Disposal and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Maintenance of Plumbing Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Electrical Services and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Building Construction Project Phase 11 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Material Schedules.

2. B — Information and Communication Technology

3. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fixings and Fittings.

4. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Waste Water Disposal.

5. D — Wear safety gear and follow instructions

6. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Building Drawing.

7. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Aided Drawing.

8. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Construction Project Phase 11.

9. C — Never touch live wires with wet hands

10. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Floor Finishes.

11. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pre-cast Concrete Products.

12. D — CPU

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Waste Water Disposal; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
